column3: CSS Animations 2 (editor's draft) makes animation-delay a shorthand of animation-delay-start and -end, which webref reads as its initial value; Chromium 156 parses neither longhand (CSS.supports false) and animation-delay as a longhand of initial 0s, and litho follows it
